How should I put it... races are, like, super heated, y'know?

This is it right here!!
This is the exact "hungry state" I was searching for!!
Heh... you're getting a pretty nice look on your face too.

Aah... so relaxing...
Maybe living here for the rest of my life wouldn't be half bad...

Haaaaah~~~ I'm back to life~~~...
The hydration is soaking into every inch of my body~~~...
(Crash...)
And now, I'm itching to run so bad I can't even stand it!

Aw, maaaaaan!!
The frustration is really building up now!!

By the way, "warriors" is just a figure of speech for Umamusume running in races—
or what chuunibyou folks call a "metaphor."

Even the quiet ones normally
lay their raw instincts bare in a race, right?
Hm... wait, did I not mention it?

Yeah, enough that if someone asked me, "Which do you like better, races or Eastern Japanese common toads?"
I'd definitely say "races"...

By deliberately distancing myself from the tension of races
and soaking in relaxation, a fierce thirst for victory is born!!

Which means we're heading back!!
Alright, pack up the coconut too!! Make sure to return it to the soil!!

While drinking the juice from the coconut Gold Ship split open with her bare hands,
the two of us, for some reason, spent a peaceful time together.

How should I put it... maybe dried wakame rehydrating in water
feels like this all the time...

Yeah, pretty much.
They always say even warriors need a place to rest, don't they?

The way back... no idea, but it's probably that way!
Come on, follow meeee!!

And then, the unstoppable impulse takes over!!
Fire!! Burning!! EXPLOSIONNN!!
Still though... this place is seriously calming...

When everyone's baring their fighting spirit and I take off my own limiter,
my whole body heats up, and it feels super invigorating.

After spending some time at this mysterious place
with Gold Ship—

My dazzling run's gonna make you AND all of America weep with joy!
WOOOOH! I'M GETTIN' FIRED UUUUUUP!!
Besides, my race is tomorrow anyway!

Hey, hey, you're slow on the uptake!!
What are you, some Nameko Alien named Nameko-hiko?!

By building up frustration before a match,
I can get totally pumped up!
Aaaaaahhhhh............

The sound of waves ebbing and flowing... what do they call it?
It's that whole "wabi-sabi" thing, right...
Isn't it nice? Spending some chill time like this every once in a while...
(Crash...)

Hey, get up, Trainer!!
We're heading back right now!! Right now!!
The sound of the waves and the sweetness of the coconut juice feel wonderful on my tired body...

Like I said, what we came here to do is done,
so we're going home!

As time passed,
I strangely started feeling like staying like this wouldn't be so bad...

My bad, my bad☆
Truth is, tomorrow's my debut race.

Aaaaaaaaaaaaarghhhhh
ーーーーーーーーーーーーー?!!

The treasure hunt that began without rhyme or reason came to an abrupt end...
(To be continued)
(Crash...)
